author: Turbo
name: Turbo plugin (server half + client module)
description: A Turbo plugin with both halves: server sources the hotel compiles (settings, a permission node, a command, named messages and their handlers) and a Nitro client module (a window, a toolbar icon, a template patch), with tests and one dev command.

pluginName.description: The plugin's class and assembly name, from -n.

key.description: The plugin's key: its folder, texts, permission nodes and client module are named by it. Default: the name in lower case.

turbo.description: The turbo-cloud checkout the server half builds against (its built server's assemblies), relative to the new plugin's folder or absolute. TurboBin overrides it with any server's bin folder.

nitro.description: The nitro-next checkout whose client module SDK the client half uses, relative to the new plugin's folder or absolute.
